change: On a Prisma P2002 acceptance conflict, roll back and retry once in a new transaction so the committed owner record can be read; classify a repeated unique conflict as a neutral normalization conflict.
isolatedPostgresqlProbeChange: A synthetic trigger raises one real SQLSTATE 23505 on ImportRecord insertion. The probe then checks one committed job, record, initial event and command after transaction retry. This proves rollback/retry; a genuine out-of-band winning writer remains untested.
scope: Local compilation and test-contract preparation only. c031147 CI did not include this change; production database conflict and old-data migration remain open.
